{{Quote|Careful Gold Seven! Watch where you're shooting!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to Flashpoint|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
'''Flashpoint''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the unit [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], under the callsign '''Gold Seven'''. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Flashpoint flew a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] during a [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] for control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].
